configuration: PKP-precursor ULVZ demo (moment-tensor mode): the same two receivers at 129.998 and 130.000 degrees and the same 600 km source and ULVZ model as the explosion deck, run once per unit moment-tensor component (1e7 dyn cm, 1 N m) as step6 does in SINGLE_FORCE_ENZ=0 mode, omega_imag 1.1e-3, 2401 s window. The deck runs at SAB_NFREQ=4 frequencies (f <= 0.001666 Hz) on 8 MPI ranks instead of the upstream 2048 frequencies (hours on hundreds of ranks); the reference is regenerated at the same count on the pinned build. Graded: for each of the six unit moment-tensor components, the non-zero components of the complex displacement spectrum of every receiver at each of the 4 graded frequencies and the matching seismograms.
observable: for each of the six unit moment-tensor components, the non-zero components of the complex displacement spectrum of every receiver at each of the 4 graded frequencies and the matching seismograms
variant: ic/variant moves every receiver distance in DATA/dist_solid_list and DATA/dist_fluid_list by +1e-07 degrees (about 1.1 cm of epicentral distance; the two tables must stay equal entry by entry because param.f stops when they differ by more than 1e-10 rad), nothing else. It is generic noise calibration: an input change far inside any real station-location uncertainty that every graded value responds to continuously, since the spectra depend on distance through the Legendre functions of the receiver angle. Two ulps of the distance (about 3e-14 degrees) were rejected as the perturbation: on the ULVZ deck they move the binary64 spectra by 4e-13 relative, below the 8e-9 relative floor of the FMA rebuild, so they would calibrate compiler noise, not input sensitivity (first packager's measurement, confirmed here: 1e-6 degrees moves the ULVZ deck's spectra by 1.5e-6 of the file peak and 1e-7 degrees by 1.5e-7 (spectra) and 1.1e-7 (seismograms), 2502 of 4352 graded values changed, a linear response).
altbuild: run.sh altbuild rebuilds the same two Fortran sources rebuilt with FMA contraction enabled (-O2 -mfma on both Makefiles, the SAC side keeping -fallow-argument-mismatch -std=legacy) instead of the upstream -O and -O3; a correct candidate could plausibly ship an FMA-contracted build on any FMA-capable x86-64 host, and contracting a*b+c into one rounding really changes the arithmetic (the first packager measured -O against -O0 bit-identical, so that pair is not usable as an alternative build here).

evidence.floor_how: measured by selfcheck on 2026-09-16: run.sh altbuild (the same two Fortran sources rebuilt with FMA contraction enabled (-O2 -mfma on both Makefiles, the SAC side keeping -fallow-argument-mismatch -std=legacy) instead of the upstream -O and -O3; a correct candidate could plausibly ship an FMA-contracted build on any FMA-capable x86-64 host, and contracting a*b+c into one rounding really changes the arithmetic (the first packager measured -O against -O0 bit-identical, so that pair is not usable as an alternative build here)) against run.sh nominal, graded with the check's own validate.py: all 5280 graded values within 1e-05 of their file's peak
evidence.fault_probes_how: native runs of the ULVZ explosion deck at 32 frequencies on 8 ranks (x86-64, gfortran 13.3, OpenMPI 4.1.6), each probe graded against the nominal run with this validator; keys ending in _spec are the worst |err| / file peak over the 32 binary64 spectrum files (vertical and radial, two receivers), _sac over the four binary32 seismograms; cutoff500 changed no value
evidence.tolerance_rationale: rtol 1e-05 of the file peak: two decades inside the 1e-3 seismological equivalence level, three decades above the measured FMA floor (1e-8) and at least 13 times under the nearest measured fault (a half-resolution radial grid, 2e-4 in the spectra); the 1e-7 degree variant sits about 60 times under it; see the warrant

warrant: The graded quantity is the displacement field the module exists to produce, per unit moment-tensor component: the frequency-domain Green's displacement dsmti writes for each receiver (binary64) and the seismogram spectotime forms from it; the off-diagonal components excite the toroidal system and the m=+-1 and +-2 azimuthal orders (comp_excitation and comp_wavefield with whole_matrix_tor in compwave.f) that no explosion deck reaches. Positions are physical identities (component, receiver in the order of the deck's tables, frequency index, time sample), never storage; the DC file freq_00000 and the identically-zero components are excluded because a zero array grades nothing. The bound is 1e-05 of each graded file's own peak magnitude, two decades inside the 1e-3 level at which two synthetic seismograms are the same answer in this field, and placed from the measured landscape of the ULVZ explosion deck at this band (worst |err| / file peak, spectra and seismograms): a ten-times coarser radial grid (6000 points) moves the graded values by 0.00098 and 0.0012, a two-times coarser one (30000) by 0.0002 and 0.00024, truncating the angular-order sum at l=100 by 0.0013 and 0.00013, dropping the imaginary frequency offset (omega_imag=0, no damping of the time-domain wraparound) by 2.6e+02 and 1.7; truncating at l=500, the last block the every-500-orders convergence test (check_amp_significance, eps 1e-12 on squared amplitude) could ever drop, changes no value at all, so a build that flips that discrete test cannot move a graded value. Every fault is at least 13 times above the bound. It is achievable because the algorithm is a deterministic linear solve with no iteration, no random draw and no reduction across ranks (each rank owns whole frequencies): the FMA rebuild moves the graded values by 1e-08 and 2.9e-08 of peak, three decades under the bound, and the 1e-7 degree variant by about 1.5e-07 and 1.1e-07. The bound is set by the packager (a decade rule anchored on the seismological equivalence level), which is why these fault probes are recorded. The check is not chaotic: there is no time stepping and no error growth; every frequency is an independent solve.
